name: Latency board
author: Switchboard examples
description: A page with live relay metrics and the slowest recent requests, a sidebar badge that counts slow ones, an Alt+L shortcut and two settings. Read-only: it never changes anything.

settings.label: Slow request threshold (ms)
settings.description: Requests that take longer than this are counted as slow and highlighted.

settings.label: Count slow requests on the sidebar
settings.description: Shows the number of slow recent requests next to Latency board, even while the page is closed.
